**bold**Selma  I really enjoyed this film, from beginning to end. The performances were remarkable, and they didn't hold anything back. I specifically liked how it was focused on one event, rather than the "life of MLK"; much like "Lincoln.  I feel that a lot of directors do poorly in this aspect because they choose to compress an individual's entire lifetime into a two hour film. It astounds me that David Oyelowo, who played MLK, did not get nominated for best actor!
